Don't copy what successful people do now. Copy what they did then.

Kevin Trudeau says most of us look at a successful person and try to copy what they do today. He says that is the wrong question.

Ask what they did when they were flat broke, in the two or three years before the money came. He says they were doing instead of talking, and they were willing to do what the other guys were not willing to do.

What are you willing to do that others aren't?

#ad #success #habits #kevintrudeau

What if the thing holding you back is your own mouth?

Kevin Trudeau asks his audience what the number one thing is that holds people back from money. Nobody guesses it. His answer is your mouth, meaning what you say.

He puts it simply: what you say is what you get. It is an idea about the everyday words we use, and how they shape what we expect.

How often do you pay attention to what you say about money?

#ad #money #mindset #kevintrudeau

Opportunities are like trains: another one is always coming.

Kevin Trudeau says opportunities in life are like trains. There is always another one on the way, so no single chance is the last one you will ever get.

He calls it less a belief and more a confidence, a knowingness, that you will have plenty of opportunities in this lifetime. You can't take every one, so take the ones you want.

His closing line: money is a renewable resource.

Which opportunity do you still think about?

#ad #money #mindset #kevintrudeau
